about: The next login after the computer restarted because of a kernel panic (docs/adr/0068-crash-evidence-and-kernel-panics.mdx, decision 3), as a Mac says it: the kernel restarted the machine by itself (kernel.panic), efi-pstore kept the panic's text across the restart, systemd-pstore brought it back and oxyos-recovery wrote its account for the person, without an address (the scenario's `panics`). As the session starts the person is told once: "Your computer restarted because of a problem." with Report…, its report written into their crash reports (so.oxy.system_<time>.crash) and the account named as told in their state folder, so the next login says nothing. Report… shows what the kernel said.
